summary: Microsoft offers up to $150,000 in Azure startup credits unlocked over time with verified progress, service adoption and sustained Azure usage; eligible Investor Network-backed startups may unlock up to $200,000. Neither maximum is guaranteed upfront. Applicants must own a software product/service, be privately held and for-profit, headquartered where Azure is available, not have received more than $350,000 lifetime free Azure credits, and not have raised Series C or later. Educational/government organizations, consultancies/agencies and cryptocurrency mining are excluded. The current application guide describes early-stage B2B startups at pre-seed through Series B, working toward or at MVP. Signup uses a personal consumer Microsoft account (not work/school/company-domain accounts), requires payment information, and the Azure Sponsorship subscription automatically converts to pay-as-you-go when credits are consumed or expire. The application guide mentions up to $150K; the Benefits page separately supports up to $200K for eligible Investor Network-backed startups, so that qualified maximum is retained. Current documentation does not state a general credit duration or claim deadline. Confirm current eligibility, allocation and expiry in the portal. No application or award/redemption was tested.
claim_steps: Apply via https://startups.microsoft.com by selecting Get started. Review the current guide's B2B, product-readiness, funding and regional eligibility.
Use a personal consumer Microsoft account, not a work/school/company-domain account; the guide lists a personal account with no prior Azure account among prerequisites.
Enter an optional 10-character Investor Network referral code if supplied by your VC/accelerator, or continue without a code.
Complete the applicable contact/business verification and Azure profile, address and payment setup.
Review portal allocation and expiry: credits unlock progressively; eligible Investor Network benefits may be higher, not guaranteed upfront.
Monitor or cancel billable resources before depletion/expiry: the guide says sponsorship automatically converts to pay-as-you-go.

social_proof.text: Unlock up to $150K in Startup credits over time as your startup demonstrates verified progress, service adoption, and sustained Azure usage.

social_proof.title: Application guide account requirements
social_proof.text: Use a personal consumer email address for the sign-up steps. Work, school, and company-domain email accounts aren't accepted (for example, connie@contoso.com).

social_proof.title: Application guide automatic billing conversion
social_proof.text: Your Azure Sponsorship subscription automatically converts to pay-as-you-go once your Azure credits are fully used or expired, whichever comes first.
